methods.name: settings.leaderboard_get
methods.effects: 读取已配置来源的校验缓存及独立排行榜偏好；不发起网络请求

methods.name: settings.leaderboard_save
methods.effects: 独立偏好文件原子写入；冲突拒绝；不修改模型配置、考试、任务或账务

methods.name: settings.leaderboard_refresh
methods.effects: 后台串行复用来源 refresh；get 返回 RUNNING/PASS/PARTIAL/ERROR/NO_ENABLED_SOURCES；每个物理 GET 复用原始回执

methods.name: settings.external_sources_refresh
methods.effects: 复用既有公开元数据刷新。切换非USD且缺少有效汇率时单次请求；已启用全来源刷新时不重复请求。

score_policy.sample_scope: per selected source before UI filters
score_policy.model_level_eci: separate reference row; never inherit into specific thinking efforts
score_policy.missing_price: keep scored known-vendor row with blank value score
